notes.title: Announcement for KAMiBAKO - Mythology of Cube - Official launch schedule
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42722813/2346330cbba9ec7ce213f15a143404d09443ab9f.jpg[/img]

To prospective Restorers,
Thank you for waiting for launch of KAMiBAKO - Mythology of Cube -!

KAMiBAKO will finally be released on January 29.

[b]- Launch date: January 29 2025 at 7:00 a.m. PST
- Supported Languages: English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese[/b]

KAMiBAKO's game system, which harmoniously combines various game genres such as map craft, puzzle, turn-base battle, and RPG, will give you a brand new playing experience you've ever met before.

Become a Restorer who saves the world by solving the 'Great division' and 'Fragmentation' in a magnificent world.

[h2]Experience the world of KAMiBAKO with demo version before launch![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2081340/KAMiBAKO__Mythology_of_Cube/

notes.title: Notice of Change of Release Date for Steam Version
notes.content:
An important announcement from the KAMiBAKO Team:

We would like to announce that the following changes have been made related to KAMiBAKO's release schedule.

[list]
[*] PS5/PS4 (Japanese)/ Nintendo Switch (Japanese）
[list]
[*] Scheduled to release on Thursday, August 29th 2024 12:00 JST
[/list]
[*] PS5/PS4 (Global version)/Nintendo Switch (Global version)/Steam (Japanese & Global version)
[list]
[*] Release date scheduled to be announced on a future date.
[/list][/list]
The Steam Japanese release of KAMiBAKO has been decided to release at the same time as the Steam Global version.
We apologize for any inconvenience for those of you who have been looking forward to playing, but we ask for your patience.

We hope you'll continue to support KAMiBAKO - Mythology of Cube -

notes.title: Update DEMO! "KAMiBAKO in 15 Minutes" game mode added!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for always following along and supporting KAMiBAKO - Mythology of Cube -! We'd like to announce that the game's demo has recently had an update.

[h3]"KAMiBAKO in 15 Minutes" game mode added![/h3]
We've compressed all essential game elements into a quick 15-minute game mode! For those of you new to the KAMiBAKO experience, you'll definitely want to give this new game mode a try!

We have also made the following additional updates, so if you're a returning player, be sure to check it out and let us know what you think:
[list]
[*] Added the ability to run while moving
[*] Redesign to the weapon crafting system
[*] Added a "Trade" feature to the land crafting system
[*] Added sub-quest system
[*] Improved operation stability
[*] Added character voice acting
[/list]
We hope you'll continue to enjoy playing KAMiBAKO - Mythology of Cube -!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2081340/
